single.rationale: Dorman shows steady operational improvement with expanding margins (42.1% gross, 14.1% operating) and consistent revenue growth (7.1% 3-year CAGR), but faces significant headwinds from customer concentration (40% from two customers), intense pricing pressure, and a sharp decline in operating cash flow (from $231M to $114M). The valuation at 18x P/E appears reasonable, but high customer concentration risk and deteriorating cash conversion warrant cautious monitoring before deeper commitment.
